==Overview==
The '''Riot Season 3 Championship Series''' is the first season of Europe's fully professional League of Legends league. Eight teams will compete in a [[round robin]] group stage, with the top 6 teams continuing on to an offline playoffs.

=== Format ===
* 10 weeks
* League play
* Each team plays all of the other teams four times 
* Each match is best of one
* Rankings are determined by the following methods:
*# Win Percentage
*# Total Wins (Or fewest losses when teams have no wins)
*# Alphabetical order
*At end of Week 10, if two teams have the same record, ties will be broken by:
*# Head to Head record
*# If still tied, a tiebreaker match will be played, with side selection determined by coin toss
